text:
Mexican Coleslaw (Spiced Up)
makes 4 cups, prep 15 min, chill 20 min
 • 1/4 cup buttermilk
 • 1/2 cup mayo
 • 1 1/2 tbsp cider vinegar
 • 1 1/2 tbsp lemon or lime juice
 • 2 tbsp sugar
 • 1 tsp salt
 • 1/2 tsp black pepper
 • 8 cups coleslaw mix, shredded green and red cabbage with carrots
 • 1 bunch cilantro, roughly chopped
 • 1 bunch green onions, about 8, minced
 • 1 jalapeno, minced
 • salt to taste

 • Combine buttermilk, mayo, vinegar, lemon juice, sugar, salt, and pepper in a small bowl or glass measuring cup.
 • In a very large bowl, combine cabbages, cilantro, onions, and jalapeno. Toss to combine.
 • Pour dressing over and toss. Chill salad about 20 min before serving.
 • Salad will reduce down quite a bit the longer it sits.
